Amanda — thanks for the clear list. Quick answers and a recommended routing so procurement can prepare the envelope without back-and-forth:

1) Signatory authority
- Redwood standard: VP Legal (Iris Kane) executes DPAs where material terms are modified or for enterprise deals.
- Delegation: our Contracts lead (Marissa Cole) has limited delegated authority to acknowledge/accept operational terms and complete routings for standard-shaped DPAs when the redlines are within pre-approved thresholds. If you need an immediate countersign prior to Iris' review, Marissa can act as the signing party, but Iris will be the formal signatory on our records for amendments > threshold.

2) Preferred routing (DocuSign template: "DPA-Standard-Exec-2026")
Option A (preferred — Redwood initiates):
  - Signer 1: Nebula Health — Execution (Sign & Date)
  - Signer 2: Redwood Contracts — Marissa Cole (Acknowledgement / Operational sign)
  - Signer 3: Redwood VP Legal — Iris Kane (Final execution, if required)

Option B (if Nebula must send):
  - Nebula sends envelope with Redwood signers added in the same order above. Please ensure email addresses match the persons below.

3) Identity verification
- For US-based signers: SMS OTP + email is sufficient.
- For EU signers or EU-located executive signers: we may require DocuSign IDV (government ID scan + selfie) depending on procurement policy. If that applies to your side, flag it now so we can provision.

4) Audit trail & retention
- We keep the full DocuSign audit trail and envelope PDF for 7 years per our retention policy and can provide a signed copy back to you once complete.

5) Logistics / timeline
- If you want us to initiate the envelope (Option A) we will use our DPA template to ensure correct field tags and audit chain — this is faster in our experience. If you prefer to send, please add Marissa (marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com) as Signer 2 and Iris (iris.kane@redwoodinference.com) as Signer 3 where applicable.

I attached our current redlines (redlines_20260722.docx) for reference. Happy to jump on a 15-min call if you want to walk through routing. Targeting Aug 5 is fine from our side.

Sean Gallagher
Sr. Dir., Sales — Redwood Inference

Amanda / Sean — a couple of operational notes from LegalOps:

- We strongly prefer Redwood to initiate the DocuSign envelope so we can enforce the DPA template and capture the audit fields consistently. If Nebula must initiate, please use the envelope name "DPA - Redwood Inference (Nebula)" and add the following signer roles exactly as below to avoid routing defects:
   * Signer 1: Customer Signer — Sign & Date (name & title fields)
   * Signer 2: Redwood Contracts — Marissa Cole — Initials where noted; checkbox for "standard redlines accepted"
   * Signer 3: Redwood VP Legal — Iris Kane — Execution signature (only populated if required; leave as recipient to obtain countersign)

- AdobeSign: we can accept AdobeSign only in exceptional cases. If you intend to use AdobeSign, Procurement must confirm and provide a signed delegation letter authorizing AdobeSign exchanges. Otherwise, DocuSign is preferred.

- IDV / KBA: Confirming Sean's note — if the signing executive is EU-located, DocuSign IDV will be requested. If your procurement team wants to avoid IDV, please indicate the signer location and we can discuss alternate verification (corporate email + procurement POC verification).

I am attaching a short delegation acknowledgement template (delegation-form.pdf) that we can countersign if you need Marissa to be the acting signatory. If you want us to initiate, please confirm and we will create the envelope today.

Laura Bennett
Sr. Counsel, Redwood Inference
